description: This file defines standard ELF types, structures, macros, and constants used for parsing and handling ELF (Executable and Linkable Format) binary files. It includes type definitions for 32-bit and 64-bit ELF structures, section and program headers, symbol tables, relocation entries, and various constants for ELF file identification, segment types, section types, dynamic tags, note sections, versioning, and architecture specifics.

classes.name: Elf32_Ehdr
classes.description: Defines the structure for 32-bit ELF file header.

classes.name: Elf64_Ehdr
classes.description: Defines the structure for 64-bit ELF file header.

classes.name: Elf32_Shdr
classes.description: Defines the section header for 32-bit ELF files.

classes.name: Elf64_Shdr
classes.description: Defines the section header for 64-bit ELF files.

classes.name: Elf32_Sym
classes.description: Defines a symbol table entry for 32-bit ELF.

classes.name: Elf64_Sym
classes.description: Defines a symbol table entry for 64-bit ELF.

classes.name: Elf32_Word
classes.description: typedef for 32-bit unsigned integer representing word or size.

classes.name: Elf64_Word
classes.description: typedef for 64-bit unsigned integer representing word or size.

classes.name: ELF_Relocation_Constants
classes.description: Defines architecture-specific ELF relocation type macros, including ARM, C-SKY, IA-64, RISC-V, and other platform-specific relocations.
